tool_args.rationale: The five initial rows were adequate to test the proposed three-parameter siphon, but fresh confirmation decisively refuted it. The remaining evidence does not identify which stationary alternative or branch is responsible. Acquire the lower-cost open-branch discriminating probe before fitting a revised model; the listed high-s_gradient probe is not in the available cost menu.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the standard two-layer siphon with a signed square-root branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation strongly refuted this model (RMSE 1.32438 versus tolerance 0.045), so refitting it without new information is not justified.
That probe is relevant to coupled memory ODE models, but the present evidence does not establish a temporal mechanism; it is costlier than the available discriminating probe.
It is explicitly nuisance data and offers no targeted resolution of the observed model refutation.
No high-frequency chaotic sign oscillation or evidence refuting all stationary smooth mechanisms has been observed.
